sources.notes: Substrait overview for structured-data compute operations, cross-language interoperability, serialized plan representations, SQL parser to execution engine use cases, and heterogeneous execution.

Specification component map for simple/compound types, type variations, user-defined types, field references, scalar/aggregate/window functions, relation basics, logical relations, text serialization, and binary serialization.
Introductory tutorial for constructing a Substrait plan from SQL with types, schemas, expressions, extensions, relations, logical-plan structure, and protobuf JSON debug representation.
Extension docs for custom data types, type variations, scalar/aggregate/window/table functions, YAML extension files, extension URNs, anchors, and interoperability beyond the base spec.
Binary serialization docs for protobuf Plan messages, extension URNs/declarations, relation trees, advanced extensions, dynamic parameters, type aliases, and execution behavior.
Producer tools page identifying Isthmus as SQL-to-Substrait Protobuf via the Calcite SQL compiler.

Substrait source repository, protobuf definitions, YAML extensions, examples, generated docs, release artifacts, and test data remain boundary-checked for notices, checksums, and redistribution before caching.
